content: सूचनम्, -ना [सूच्-भावे ल्युट्] .²1 The act of piercing or perforating, boring, perforation. .²2 Pointing out, indication, intimation. .²3 Informing against, betraying, calumniating, traducing. .²4 Gesticulation, indicating by proper signs or gestures. .²5 Hinting, hint. .²6 Information. .²7 Teaching, showing, describing. .²8 Spying out, spying, seeing, ascertaining. .²9 Villainy, wickedness. .²10 Hurting, killing.
